host_representation: MIR signed i64 / C int64_t; not a change to PL/I precision
proof: Signed remainder r has -(b-1)<=r<=b-1. Nonnegative r is already floor modulo; negative r corresponds to truncation quotient one above floor, so adding b gives a-b*floor(a/b). All i64 arithmetic is far from overflow.
reference: For a<0 descend q and multiple together from zero until q*b<=a; for a>=0 use repeated subtraction. Then compute a-b*q and check q*b<=a<(q+1)*b. No signed remainder/correction in reference.
